sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Prerna and her younger sister are watching a sports channel on television.
sections.source_evidence: Prerna and her younger sister are watching a sports channel on television.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: Prerna enjoys running and she has been declared the fastest runner among the girls in her district for winning the 100 metre sprint at an interschool competition held at the district level.
sections.source_evidence: Prerna enjoys running and she has been declared the fastest runner among the girls in her district for winning the 100 metre sprint at an interschool competition held at the district level.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: She is now training to compete at the state level.
sections.source_evidence: She is now training to compete at the state level.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: She dreams of representing India at the international level in 100 metre sprint contests in future.
sections.source_evidence: She dreams of representing India at the international level in 100 metre sprint contests in future.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: While watching the rerun of sprints at the Olympic games held in the past, Prerna is always amazed that the measurement of the time taken for the race is so advanced that they could identify the winner even when two sprinters seemed to cross the ﬁ nish line almost together.
sections.source_evidence: While watching the rerun of sprints at the Olympic games held in the past, Prerna is always amazed that the measurement of the time taken for the race is so advanced that they could identify the winner even when two sprinters seemed to cross the ﬁ nish line almost together.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: However, in her school, the sports teacher only used a special kind of watch called a ‘stopwatch’ for timing the school races.
sections.source_evidence: However, in her school, the sports teacher only used a special kind of watch called a ‘stopwatch’ for timing the school races.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: She had noticed her mother wearing a watch on her wrist and her sister looking at her mobile phone when she needed to check the time.
sections.source_evidence: She had noticed her mother wearing a watch on her wrist and her sister looking at her mobile phone when she needed to check the time.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Her uncle used a Braille watch and had recently acquired a talking watch that announced the time at the touch of a button.
sections.source_evidence: Her uncle used a Braille watch and had recently acquired a talking watch that announced the time at the touch of a button.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: There was also a large clock on the wall near the school entrance.
sections.source_evidence: There was also a large clock on the wall near the school entrance.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Her thoughts turned to people in the ancient past, who did not have the modern gadgets we have today and she wondered… Measurement of Time and Motion 8

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: Curiosity | Textbook of Science | Grade 7 106 8.1 Measurement of Time Humans got interested in keeping track of time long ago.
sections.source_evidence: Curiosity | Textbook of Science | Grade 7 106 8.1 Measurement of Time Humans got interested in keeping track of time long ago.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: They started noticing that many events in nature repeat themselves after definite intervals of time.
sections.source_evidence: They started noticing that many events in nature repeat themselves after definite intervals of time.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: For example, the rising and setting of the Sun, the phases of the Moon and the changing seasons.
sections.source_evidence: For example, the rising and setting of the Sun, the phases of the Moon and the changing seasons.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: They started using the cycles of these events for timekeeping.
sections.source_evidence: They started using the cycles of these events for timekeeping.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: A day was defined by the cycle of rising and setting of the Sun.
sections.source_evidence: A day was defined by the cycle of rising and setting of the Sun.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: Then began the quest to find ways of knowing the time of day.
sections.source_evidence: Then began the quest to find ways of knowing the time of day.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: How was time measured when there were no clocks and watches?
sections.source_evidence: How was time measured when there were no clocks and watches?

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: So, they made many devices which helped them to measure smaller intervals of time within a day.
sections.source_evidence: So, they made many devices which helped them to measure smaller intervals of time within a day.

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: Some of these were sundials, water clocks, hourglasses, and candle clocks.
sections.source_evidence: Some of these were sundials, water clocks, hourglasses, and candle clocks.
